annotations.title: Live: how the app is doing

description: Reads the Live app in one call: people who joined and were active this calendar month against last month, refund-aware revenue this month against last (per currency, minor units), subscribers by plan, errors in the last 24 hours and their codes, what waits on the founder (approvals asked in their browser, unanswered Inbox conversations, refusals on the Logs page's own Errors section), and whether Live is paused. subscribers.byPlan[].count is everyone on the plan; byPlan[].paying is the ones who pay — never a comped subscriber, one in a free trial, or a Stripe subscription not being charged (unpaid, paused, incomplete); byPlan[].comped is how many are comped (the founder's own grant). MRR is each plan's monthly price × paying, never × count — say it the way the dashboard does, e.g. "3 subscribers · 2 paying, 1 comped". The first read for "how is the app doing?"; live_errors, live_usage, live_webhooks, live_emails and live_inbox go deeper. live:read; audited; changes nothing.
